general: Only when the source shows a flat cream #f5efe4 background with a central illustration or photo, keep that background flat and assign all extra canvas area to the background or photo, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows the NOA logo as a circular cup icon plus NOA wordmark, preserve its aspect ratio and use the dark #4a2f22 version on cream or the cream version on dark brown at the same relative size, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a dark brown #4a2f22 or orange #d97b3f promo panel, keep that panel colour, its rounded corners, and its fixed proportional size while the surrounding cream or photo area flexes, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a central mug illustration or product photo, keep it centred horizontally and proportionally scaled with extra space absorbed around it, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows brand colour accents, use only #4a2f22 for primary text and dark panels, #d97b3f for the orange promo panel, #e8b04b for the smaller promo subline, and #f5efe4 for light backgrounds and light text, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a headline with a smaller subline, keep the headline at least twice the subline height and keep the subline directly beneath it with the same alignment, otherwise keep the source structure.

ig-feed-11: Only when adapting the 1:1 layout that shows the logo without a top band, place the dark logo at the top-right at approximately 19% of canvas width with approximately 7% right margin and 5% top margin, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when adapting the 1:1 layout that shows a bottom promo panel, keep the dark brown #4a2f22 rounded panel inset approximately 8% on each side at approximately 84% width and 18% height with approximately 6% bottom margin, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when adapting the 1:1 layout that shows the central mug, keep the mug centred at approximately 27% of canvas width in the middle of the cream field above the bottom panel, otherwise keep the source structure.
ig-story-916: Only when adapting the 9:16 layout that shows a top band, keep the dark brown #4a2f22 band full-bleed at approximately 15% of canvas height with the light logo centred inside it at approximately 25% of canvas width, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when adapting the 9:16 layout that shows a bottom promo panel, keep the orange #d97b3f rounded panel centred at approximately 76% width and 11% height with approximately 6% bottom margin, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when adapting the 9:16 layout, assign all extra vertical height to the cream space between the central mug at approximately 28% width and the bottom orange panel, otherwise keep the source structure.

never: Never add an extra top band, bottom band, tab, side panel, or frame that is not visible in the source creative.
Never add a second logo, badge, sticker, button, CTA, or icon beyond the logo and central element visible in the source creative.
Never add borders, outlines, shadows, or decorative shapes around the logo, illustration, photo, or promo panel when the source shows none.
Never invent additional Hebrew or English text, prices, dates, or promotional claims beyond what is visible in the source creative.

proportions.element: top cream text panel above photo (general photo layout)

text: Hebrew text is set right-to-left with the headline larger and bolder than the subline directly beneath it when both are visible.
When the logo tagline is visible on cream, it is small, brown, and right-aligned beneath the top-right logo.
When headline and subline are centred on cream or on a promo panel, keep both centre-aligned with the subline in a smaller size and, on the dark panel, in #e8b04b beneath cream headline text.
When a subline contains details separated by a middle dot, keep the dot separator and keep numerals and dates in the smaller subline size, never in the headline.
